summary: Republic of Uzbekistan. Presidential republic; highly authoritarian.
rulers: President Shavkat MIRZIYOYEV (since 14 December 2016); Prime Minister Abdulla ARIPOV (since 14 December 2016)
economy: lower-middle income Central Asian economy; key exporter of natural gas, cotton, and gold; ongoing reform efforts to reduce state-owned sector dominance, attract foreign investment, and improve sustainability of cotton production GDP (PPP): $379.989 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Armed Forces of Uzbekistan: Army, Air and Air Defense Forces; National Guard Ministry of Internal Affairs: Internal Security Troops, Border Guards, police (2024) Expenditure: 2.8% of GDP (2019 est.)

sourceFields.militaryNotes: note 1: the National Guard is under the Defense Ministry, but is independent of the other military services; it is responsible for ensuring public order and the security of diplomatic missions, radio and television broadcasting, and other state entities note 2: the State Security Service, whose chairperson reports directly to the president, is responsible for national security and intelligence matters, including terrorism, corruption, organized crime, border control, and narcotics
